select TRAIN_DIFF_CODE, get_global_name(t.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) TRAINTYPECODE, TRAINFORMCODE, COURSE_NAME_CODE, COUNTS, NUMB, TOTALPT, ALLTIME, round(ALLTIME/NUMB,2) AVGTIME, ALLCOST, ZHIJIECOUST, JIANJIECOUST, round(ALLCOST/NUMB,2) AVGCOST from (select p.TRAIN_DIFF_CODE, p.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE, p.COURSE_NAME_CODE, get_global_name(p.train_form_code,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) TRAINFORMCODE, count(p.plan_no) COUNTS, sum((select count(*) from edu_free_employee e where e.basic_no = b.basic_no)) NUMB, to_number(sum(case when IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT = 2 THEN IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR WHEN IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT = 1 THEN TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) * 8) WHEN IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT = 0 THEN TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) * 30 * 8) ELSE '0' END)) ALLTIME, sum((select count(*) from edu_free_employee e where e.basic_no = b.basic_no)) * sum(case when IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT = 2 THEN IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR WHEN IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT = 1 THEN TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) * 24) WHEN IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT = 0 THEN TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) * 30 * 24) ELSE '0' END) TOTALPT, to_number(sum(TEACHER_COST + MATERIAL_COST + FIELD_COST + FOOD_COST + STAY_COST + TRAFFIC_COST + VISA_COST + OTHER_COST)) ALLCOST, to_number(sum(TEACHER_COST+MATERIAL_COST+FIELD_COST)) ZHIJIECOUST, to_number(sum(FOOD_COST + STAY_COST + TRAFFIC_COST + VISA_COST + OTHER_COST)) JIANJIECOUST from edu_plan_manager p, edu_basic_information b, edu_cost_manager c where p.plan_no = b.plan_no and b.basic_no = c.basic_no and p.cpny_id = b.cpny_id and p.cpny_id = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
p.TRAIN_DIFF_CODE=#TRAIN_DIFF_CODE:VARCHAR#
p.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE=#TRAIN_TYPE_CODE:VARCHAR#
p.COURSE_NAME_CODE like '%'||#COURSE_NAME_CODE:VARCHAR#||'%'
group by p.TRAIN_DIFF_CODE, p.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE, p.COURSE_NAME_CODE,p.train_form_code) t

select get_global_name(t.post_grade_no, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) grade_name, COUNTS, NUMB, AVGCOUTS, TRAINFORMCODE, ALLTIME, AVGTIME, ALLCOST, AVGCOST, TOTALPT, ZHIJIECOUST, JIANJIECOUST from (select h.post_grade_no, COUNT(*) COUNTS, count(e.empid) NUMB, count(e.empid)/COUNT(*) AVGCOUTS, get_global_name(p.train_form_code,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) TRAINFORMCODE, sum(IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) ALLTIME, ROUND(sum(IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) / count(e.empid),2) AVGTIME, ROUND(sum(TEACHER_COST + MATERIAL_COST + FIELD_COST + FOOD_COST + STAY_COST + TRAFFIC_COST + VISA_COST + OTHER_COST) / count(e.empid) ,2)AVGCOST, count(e.empid)*sum(IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) TOTALPT, to_number(sum(TEACHER_COST + MATERIAL_COST + FIELD_COST + FOOD_COST + STAY_COST + TRAFFIC_COST + VISA_COST + OTHER_COST)) ALLCOST, to_number(sum(TEACHER_COST+MATERIAL_COST+FIELD_COST)) ZHIJIECOUST, to_number(sum(FOOD_COST + STAY_COST + TRAFFIC_COST + VISA_COST + OTHER_COST)) JIANJIECOUST from edu_basic_information b, edu_free_employee e, edu_cost_manager c, edu_plan_manager p, hr_employee h where b.basic_no = e.basic_no and b.basic_no = c.basic_no and b.cpny_id = h.cpny_id and p.plan_no = b.plan_no and e.empid = h.empid and b.cpny_id = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
get_global_name(h.post_grade_no, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) like '%'||#POST_GRADE_NAME:VARCHAR#||'%'
GROUP BY h.post_grade_no,p.train_form_code) t

select GET_DEPT_NAME(t.deptno, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) dept_name, COUNTS, NUMB, TRAINFORMCODE, AVGCOUTS, ALLTIME, AVGTIME, ALLCOST, AVGCOST, TOTALPT, ZHIJIECOUST, JIANJIECOUST from (select h.deptno, COUNT(*) COUNTS, count(e.empid) NUMB, count(e.empid)/COUNT(*) AVGCOUTS, get_global_name(p.train_form_code,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) TRAINFORMCODE, sum(IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) ALLTIME, ROUND(sum(IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) / count(e.empid),2) AVGTIME, ROUND(sum(TEACHER_COST + MATERIAL_COST + FIELD_COST + FOOD_COST + STAY_COST + TRAFFIC_COST + VISA_COST + OTHER_COST) / count(e.empid) ,2)AVGCOST, count(e.empid)*sum(IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) TOTALPT, to_number(sum(TEACHER_COST + MATERIAL_COST + FIELD_COST + FOOD_COST + STAY_COST + TRAFFIC_COST + VISA_COST + OTHER_COST)) ALLCOST, to_number(sum(TEACHER_COST+MATERIAL_COST+FIELD_COST)) ZHIJIECOUST, to_number(sum(FOOD_COST + STAY_COST + TRAFFIC_COST + VISA_COST + OTHER_COST)) JIANJIECOUST from edu_basic_information b, edu_free_employee e, edu_cost_manager c, edu_plan_manager p, hr_employee h where b.basic_no = e.basic_no and b.basic_no = c.basic_no and b.cpny_id = h.cpny_id and p.plan_no = b.plan_no and e.empid = h.empid and b.cpny_id = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
EXISTS (SELECT * FROM HR_DEPARTMENT B1 WHERE B1.DEPTNO = H.DEPTNO START WITH B1.DEPTNO = #DEPTNO# CONNECT BY PRIOR B1.DEPTNO = B1.PARENT_DEPT_NO)
GROUP BY h.deptno,p.train_form_code) t

select YEAR, COUNTS, NUMB, TRAINFORMCODE, round(COUNTS/NUMB,2) AVGCOUTS, ALLTIME, round(ALLTIME/NUMB,2) AVGTIME, ALLCOST, ZHIJIECOUST, JIANJIECOUST, round(ALLCOST/NUMB,2) AVGCOST FROM (select to_char(b.IMPLE_START_DATE, 'YYYY') YEAR, COUNT(*) COUNTS, get_global_name(p.train_form_code,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) TRAINFORMCODE, sum((select count(*) from edu_free_employee e where e.basic_no = b.basic_no)) NUMB, sum(CASE WHEN IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT = '2' THEN IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR WHEN IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT = '1' THEN TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) * 24) WHEN IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT = '0' THEN TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) * 30 * 24) ELSE '0' END) ALLTIME, sum((select count(*) from edu_free_employee e where e.basic_no = b.basic_no)) * sum(CASE WHEN IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT = '2' THEN IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR WHEN IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT = '1' THEN TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) * 24) WHEN IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT = '0' THEN TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) * 30 * 24) ELSE '0' END) TOTALPT, sum(TEACHER_COST + MATERIAL_COST + FIELD_COST + FOOD_COST + STAY_COST + TRAFFIC_COST + VISA_COST + OTHER_COST) ALLCOST, to_number(sum(TEACHER_COST+MATERIAL_COST+FIELD_COST)) ZHIJIECOUST, to_number(sum(FOOD_COST + STAY_COST + TRAFFIC_COST + VISA_COST + OTHER_COST)) JIANJIECOUST from edu_basic_information b, edu_cost_manager c ,edu_plan_manager p where b.basic_no = c.basic_no and p.plan_no = b.plan_no and b.cpny_id=#CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
to_char(b.IMPLE_START_DATE, 'YYYY') = #COURSE_DATE:VARCHAR#
GROUP BY to_char(b.IMPLE_START_DATE, 'YYYY'),p.train_form_code)t

select MONTH, COUNTS, TRAINFORMCODE, NUMB, round(COUNTS / NUMB, 2) AVGCOUTS, ALLTIME, round(ALLTIME / NUMB, 2) AVGTIME, ALLCOST, TOTALPT, ZHIJIECOUST, JIANJIECOUST, round(ALLCOST / NUMB, 2) AVGCOST from (select to_char(b.IMPLE_START_DATE, 'MMYYYY') MONTH, get_global_name(p.train_form_code,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) TRAINFORMCODE, COUNT(*) COUNTS, sum((select count(*) from edu_free_employee e where e.basic_no = b.basic_no)) NUMB, sum(CASE WHEN IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT = '2' THEN IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR WHEN IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT = '1' THEN TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) * 24) WHEN IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT = '0' THEN TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) * 30 * 24) ELSE '0' END) ALLTIME, sum((select count(*) from edu_free_employee e where e.basic_no = b.basic_no)) * sum(CASE WHEN IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT = '2' THEN IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR WHEN IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT = '1' THEN TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) * 24) WHEN IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT = '0' THEN TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) * 30 * 24) ELSE '0' END) TOTALPT, sum(TEACHER_COST + MATERIAL_COST + FIELD_COST + FOOD_COST + STAY_COST + TRAFFIC_COST + VISA_COST + OTHER_COST) ALLCOST, to_number(sum(TEACHER_COST+MATERIAL_COST+FIELD_COST)) ZHIJIECOUST, to_number(sum(FOOD_COST + STAY_COST + TRAFFIC_COST + VISA_COST + OTHER_COST)) JIANJIECOUST from edu_basic_information b, edu_cost_manager c,edu_plan_manager p where b.basic_no = c.basic_no and p.plan_no = b.plan_no and b.cpny_id=#CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
to_char(b.IMPLE_START_DATE, 'MMYYYY')=#COURSE_DATE:VARCHAR#
GROUP BY to_char(b.IMPLE_START_DATE, 'MMYYYY'),p.train_form_code) t

select get_global_name(t.train_form_code, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) train_form_code, COUNTS, NUMB, round(COUNTS / NUMB, 2) AVGCOUTS, ALLTIME, round(ALLTIME / NUMB, 2) AVGTIME, ALLCOST, TOTALPT, ZHIJIECOUST, JIANJIECOUST, round(ALLCOST / NUMB, 2) AVGCOST from (select p.train_form_code, COUNT(*) COUNTS, SUM((select count(*) from edu_free_employee e where e.basic_no = b.basic_no)) NUMB, sum(CASE WHEN IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT = '2' THEN IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR WHEN IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT = '1' THEN TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) * 24) WHEN IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT = '0' THEN TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) * 30 * 24) ELSE '0' END) ALLTIME, SUM((select count(*) from edu_free_employee e where e.basic_no = b.basic_no)) * sum(CASE WHEN IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT = '2' THEN IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR WHEN IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT = '1' THEN TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) * 24) WHEN IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT = '0' THEN TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) * 30 * 24) ELSE '0' END) TOTALPT, sum(TEACHER_COST + MATERIAL_COST + FIELD_COST + FOOD_COST + STAY_COST + TRAFFIC_COST + VISA_COST + OTHER_COST) ALLCOST, to_number(sum(TEACHER_COST+MATERIAL_COST+FIELD_COST)) ZHIJIECOUST, to_number(sum(FOOD_COST + STAY_COST + TRAFFIC_COST + VISA_COST + OTHER_COST)) JIANJIECOUST from edu_basic_information b, edu_plan_manager p, edu_cost_manager c where b.basic_no = c.basic_no and b.plan_no = p.plan_no and b.cpny_id = p.cpny_id and b.cpny_id = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
p.train_form_code=#TRAIN_FORM_CODE:VARCHAR#
GROUP BY p.train_form_code) t
